To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) Maximum likelihood training leads to overfitting to spurious features, (2) Information bottleneck (IB) training reduces the dependence on spurious correlations, (3) Entropy penalty, a regularization method based on IB, reduces the dependence on non-robust correlations and allows deep networks to generalize well even on OOD data.

(i) maximum likelihood training without appropriate regularization leads the model to exploit spurious features, and (ii) Entropy Penalty, based on information bottleneck, can address this problem and improve generalization beyond the IID assumption.
